$comment: 听力训练营 L01（PL0-4 样课）。脚本 100% 原创，题材：学校的一天；只练 Part 1 三图单选，5 题，每题一段 4-6 句短对话 + 3 张 SVG 图（icon 见 icons.json）。词汇 ≥95% 落在 KET A2 词表内，超出的词进 warmup。语速 0.8x（阶段一）。
title: A Day at School
intro: 今天听的是校园里的五段小对话：几点出发、怎么去学校、午饭吃什么、下午做什么、放学在哪儿见。先把下面的词听熟。

sections.intro: 听一段短对话，选出正确的图。

script.text: Mum, what time does the school bus leave tomorrow?
It usually leaves at eight o'clock, but tomorrow it's leaving at half past seven because of the school trip.
Half past seven? That's early!
Yes, so you must get up at seven. I'll call you.

questions.q: What time does the school bus leave tomorrow?
questions.explain: 关键句是 but 后面的 tomorrow it's leaving at half past seven（7:30）。8 点是平时（usually）的出发时间，7 点是起床时间。听到 usually… but… 要警觉：答案常在 but 后面。

sections.intro: 听一段短对话，选出正确的图。

script.text: Dad, can you drive me to school today? It's raining.
Sorry, Anna, the car is at the garage today. Why don't you take the bus?
The bus is always late. I'll go by bike and wear my raincoat.
All right. Be careful on the road.

questions.q: How is Anna going to school today?
questions.explain: 三种交通工具都出现了：car 在修车厂去不了，bus 总是迟到，最后 Anna 说 I'll go by bike。选图题要听到最后一句再决定。

sections.intro: 听一段短对话，选出正确的图。

script.text: What are you having for lunch, Ben? Pizza again?
No, there's no pizza today. I wanted a sandwich, but they only had egg sandwiches, and I don't like eggs.
So what did you get?
Pasta with cheese. It's really nice!

questions.q: What is Ben having for lunch?
questions.explain: pizza 今天没有（there's no pizza today），sandwich 只有鸡蛋味的他不喜欢，最后拿的是 pasta。被问 what did you get 之后的那句才是答案。

sections.intro: 听一段短对话，选出正确的图。

script.text: Listen, everyone. We can't use the sports hall this afternoon, so there's no football.
Can we go swimming then, Miss Green?
The swimming pool is closed on Mondays. We're going to paint pictures in the art room.
Great! I love painting.

questions.q: What is the class going to do this afternoon?
questions.explain: football 因为体育馆用不了取消了，游泳池周一关门，老师最后说 We're going to paint pictures。going to 后面的动作才是要做的事。

sections.intro: 听一段短对话，选出正确的图。

script.text: Mum, where shall I meet you after school? At the school gate?
No, I have to go to the library first. Meet me in the park next to the library, near the big tree.
OK, and can we go to the shop after that? I need a new pen.
Yes, if we have time.

questions.q: Where is Lucy going to meet her mum after school?
questions.explain: library 是妈妈自己先去的地方，shop 是见面之后可能去的地方，见面地点是 Meet me in the park。注意 first / after that 这些先后顺序词。
